//: Type-checks src AND tests. The build config sets rootDir ./src while including tests/**/*, so a plain `tsc --noEmit` fails with TS6059 before it checks anything; every test file therefore went unchecked until 2026-09-02. `pnpm build` still uses tsconfig.json, so this file cannot change what tsup's --dts emits.
//exclude: Restated on purpose. `exclude` is inherited from the extended config and filters `include`, so a package that later excludes "tests" there would silently drop every test file out of this program and each type guarantee in them would pass vacuously.
